title: Director, Global Training - Corporate Travel Operations
text:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Director, Global Training & Enablement is a strategic leader responsible for designing, building, and scaling a unified global training model that supports Direct Travel's "Everyone Is a VIP" operating vision. This role owns the end-to-end training function—from curriculum development through delivery, certification, and continuous improvement—ensuring advisors across all regions, service locations, and delivery partners deliver world-class service on the Avenir platform at enterprise scale.

This position blends strategic program ownership with hands-on team leadership, driving consistency, operational excellence, and measurable service impact across all geographies and service lines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Global Training Strategy & Unified Model Leadership**

* Own and execute the **five-pillar global training model**: Unified Team, Unified Curriculum, Unified Intake, Unified Delivery, and Unified Tracking
* Establish and lead the **Global Enterprise Training Team (HUB)**, implementing a train-the-trainer model across all service locations and delivery teams
* Define and maintain **one mandatory core curriculum path** for every advisor role globally, with role-based elective catalogs
* Ensure training aligns with **COO strategic priorities**: "Everyone Is a VIP," margin expansion, and scalable service delivery without proportional headcount growth
* Build **Avenir platform-specific training** covering conversational booking, disruption management, trip queries, advisor-in-platform workflows, and exception management
* Create **global service standards** while enabling market-specific delivery and localization (language, currency, regulations, cultural nuance)

* **Training Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a global team of **certified Enterprise Trainers** across multiple regions and time zones
* Establish and operationalize **trainer certification program** with recertification cycles tied to platform releases and curriculum updates
* Provide weekly team updates, performance feedback, and coaching on training effectiveness and learner outcomes
* Build **train-the-trainer capability** across all service locations to scale training delivery without proportional cost growth
* Establish a regular **trainer alignment cadence** across all locations to ensure consistency, share best practices, and cascade product/platform changes
* Hold trainers accountable to **learner feedback scores** and training effectiveness metrics

* **Avenir & Platform-Specific Curriculum Development**

* Design and maintain **Avenir-focused training modules** covering:
* + Agentic AI workflows and exception management
 + Conversational booking and trip management via chat, SMS, WhatsApp, and voice
 + Predictive disruption signals and proactive rebooking
 + Dynamic policy compliance and automated approvals
 + Profile depth and traveler intent anticipation
 + One-platform orchestration (air, hotel, rail, car, expense, payments, risk, comms)
* Create training for **AI-assisted tools and automation**
* Ensure advisors understand their role as **Experience Managers, not transaction processors**—focusing on exceptions, nuance, and high-value client interactions
* Develop **change management training** for platform releases, new AI capabilities, and policy/workflow updates

* **Service Delivery Model Enablement & Transition Readiness**

* Lead **onboarding readiness** for work transitions and service delivery model changes, ensuring advisors in all locations are equipped to handle Core, Avenir, and GDS servicing
* Develop **scalable, localized training** that maintains global standards while reflecting local market requirements, regulations, and cultural context
* Support **new market and location launches** with training frameworks adaptable across all regions and markets
* Partner with **Operations leadership** to align training timelines with capacity plans and work transition schedules
* Build **follow-the-sun training support** that scales with the service footprint, ensuring advisors in every time zone can access to learning resources and trainer guidance

* **Unified Intake, Delivery & Tracking**

* Establish **one standard global training request form** auto-routed to certified trainers with defined SLAs and lead times
* Implement **single global Learning Management System (LMS)** with real-time dashboards tracking:
* + Learner progress, compliance, and pass/fail reporting
 + Training completion and role-based certification status
 + Trainer effectiveness scored via learner feedback
 + Performance analytics linked to operational KPIs (SLA, quality, productivity)
* Design **multiple delivery modalities**: instructor-led, e-learning self-paced, job aids, workflow guides, and peer coaching
* Establish **standard global communication methods** (email, chat, escalations) for training support and change notifications
* Define **change management workflow** for curriculum updates, ensuring rapid deployment of product/platform changes

* **Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Track and report **training effectiveness metrics** aligned to operational impact:
* + Advisor productivity and quality improvements post-training
 + SLA attainment and consistency across regions
 + AI tool adoption rates and workflow automation compliance
 + Learner satisfaction and trainer effectiveness scores
* Implement **post-training evaluations and performance assessments** to validate skill mastery and readiness
* Establish **continuous improvement cadence** (monthly) with Global Training Council to escalate insights, approve content changes, and refine delivery
* Publish **Year 1 capability report** to leadership demonstrating training ROI and operational impact
* Link training outcomes to **global talent development** and career progression

* **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Partner with **Efficiency & Operations teams** to translate workflow automation and AI initiatives into training content
* Collaborate with **Product teams** on Avenir training and platform readiness
* Align with **GDS, Core Product Support, and Avenir Product Support** teams on platform-specific curriculum
* Establish **Global Training Governance** with clear ownership, escalation paths, and decision rights
* Support **enterprise-wide transformation initiatives**, embedding training into PMO and change management workflows

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **5+ years** in travel operations, training, workforce enablement, or related function
* **Proven experience managing a team of trainers or learning professionals** across multiple regions
* **Deep expertise in corporate travel operations**, GDS platforms (Sabre, Amadeus), and international ticketing
* **Demonstrated ability designing and scaling training programs** across geographies, cultures, and time zones
* **Strong communication and facilitation skills**; ability to simplify complex technical and operational topics
* **Global mindset and comfort working across time zones**, cultures, and organizational boundaries
* **Project management discipline** with ability to manage multiple workstreams and timelines simultaneously

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience with **multi-location or global service delivery models and distributed team leadership**
* **Hands-on knowledge of Avenir platform** or similar modern travel booking/servicing systems
* Background with **AI/automation tools** (including agentic AI platforms)
* Familiarity with **workflow automation** or **agent-assist technologies**
* **LMS implementation or administration** experience (configuration, reporting, user management)
* Experience in a **fast-paced, transformation-focused environment** with rapid platform/product evolution
* **Training ROI analysis** and ability to link learning outcomes to operational metrics

**SUCCESS MEASURES (FIRST 12–18 MONTHS)**

* **Global training framework** (five pillars) established, approved, and operationalized across Direct Travel and ATPI
* **Avenir platform training** fully developed and deployed; 90%+ advisor proficiency on core workflows
* **Global Enterprise Training Team (HUB)** stood up with certified trainers across regions; train-the-trainer model active
* **Onboarding readiness** achieved; service delivery and work transitions supported with zero training-readiness gaps
* **Single global LMS** live with real-time dashboards; 100% training compliance tracking across all advisors
* **Unified intake process** live; training SLAs met with <5% variance across regions
* **Advisor productivity and quality improvements** measurable post-training (target: 10–15% efficiency gain, consistent SLA attainment)
* **AI tool adoption** at 80%+ usage rates
* **Trainer effectiveness scores** averaging 4.2+/5.0 on learner feedback; continuous improvement cadence established
* **New market and location launch training** embedded in operational rhythm across all regions

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* **Willing to travel 15–25%** as needed to support service locations and global training initiatives
* **Flexibility to work across time zones** for trainer alignment calls, global stand-ups, and 24/7 training support model
* **Comfort with ambiguity and rapid change** in a transformation-focused environment
